EduAll Dataset — Exploration Code¶

Single-notebook version of the exploration code used in the thesis (exploration_groupwork/scripts/). Each section corresponds to one figure script (f01...f30) plus the shared helpers (common.py) and the numbers quoted in the report (make_numbers.py). Figures are displayed inline; the underlying .py scripts remain the source of truth for the written report.

Run this notebook from the exploration_groupwork/ folder (it loads ../data/EduAll_500_Applications_Dataset.csv).

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(".").resolve()                            # run from exploration_groupwork/
CSV = ROOT.parent / "data" / "EduAll_500_Applications_Dataset.csv"
FIG = ROOT / "figures"
FIG.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

BUDGET = 500_000
REQUIRED = {"Bachelor's": 40, "Master's": 12, "Doctoral": 12}
FT_SEMESTERS = {"Bachelor's": 6, "Master's": 4, "Doctoral": 8}   # standard full-time length
CAP = {"Bachelor's": 8_000, "Master's": 6_500, "Doctoral": 5_000}
LEVELS = ["Bachelor's", "Master's", "Doctoral"]
CITY = {"EPFL": "Lausanne", "ETH Zurich": "Zurich", "University of Zurich": "Zurich",
        "University of Geneva": "Geneva", "University of Lausanne": "Lausanne",
        "University of Basel": "Basel", "University of Bern": "Bern",
        "University of St. Gallen": "St. Gallen", "University of Lucerne": "Lucerne",
        "University of Neuchâtel": "Neuchâtel", "University of Fribourg": "Fribourg",
        "Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH)": "Bern",
        "HES-SO University of Applied Sciences (La Source, Lausanne)": "Lausanne",
        "Università della Svizzera Italiana (USI)": "Lugano"}
RISK = ["risk_first_generation", "risk_refugee_asylum", "risk_disability",
        "risk_housing_insecurity", "risk_family_emergency", "risk_language_barrier",
        "risk_parent_student", "risk_undocumented_status"]
RESIL = ["resilience_volunteer_experience", "resilience_work_experience",
         "resilience_leadership_role", "resilience_community_engagement",
         "resilience_overcame_adversity"]
LABEL = {c: c.split("_", 1)[1].replace("_", " ").capitalize() for c in RISK + RESIL}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- style
TIER_COL = {1: "#1b6ca8", 2: "#f0a202", 3: "#8c8c8c"}
LEVEL_COL = {"Bachelor's": "#2a9d8f", "Master's": "#e76f51", "Doctoral": "#6d597a"}
RULE_COL = {"Need-first": "#d62828", "Weighted score": "#003049",
            "Proportional": "#f77f00", "Lottery": "#7a9e7e"}


def style():
    mpl.rcParams.update({
        "figure.dpi": 100, "savefig.bbox": "tight", "font.size": 9,
        "axes.titlesize": 10, "axes.labelsize": 9, "legend.fontsize": 8,
        "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False,
        "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.25, "grid.linewidth": 0.5,
        "pdf.fonttype": 42, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans"})


def save(fig, name: str):
    """Save a figure as a vector PDF in figures/ and close it."""
    fig.savefig(FIG / f"{name}.pdf")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("saved", name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- data
def load(savings_buffer: float = 3_000, count_savings: bool = True,
         count_scholarship: bool = True) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Load the CSV and add the derived decision variables.

    savings_buffer   : CHF of savings left untouched as an emergency reserve.
    count_savings    : if True, savings above the buffer are spread evenly over
                       the applicant's remaining months of study and the share
                       falling in the grant period reduces the period need.
    count_scholarship: if True, other scholarships (CHF/year) reduce the
                       period need pro rata.
    """
    df = pd.read_csv(CSV, keep_default_na=False)
    df["city"] = df.university.map(CITY)
    df["generation"] = np.where(df.age <= 29, "Gen Z (18-29)", "Millennial (30-45)")
    df["required"] = df.study_level.map(REQUIRED)
    df["progress"] = df.courses_completed / df.required
    df["pace"] = df.courses_completed / df.semesters_in_program
    df["part_time"] = df.study_mode == "Part-time"
    df["switcher"] = df.part_time & (df.planned_study_mode_2027 == "Full-time")
    # Semesters still needed after summer 2026, at the applicant's own pace. Part-time students
    # who switch to full-time in September 2027 keep their pace for two more semesters and then
    # progress at the standard full-time pace of their level.
    left = (df.required - df.courses_completed) / df.pace
    ft_pace = df.required / df.study_level.map(FT_SEMESTERS)
    left_after_two = (df.required - df.courses_completed - 2 * df.pace).clip(lower=0)
    switch_left = 2 + left_after_two / np.maximum(ft_pace, df.pace)
    left = np.where(df.switcher, np.where(left_after_two > 0, switch_left, left), left)
    df["sem_left_now"] = np.floor(left + 0.5).clip(min=1).astype(int)
    # Two semesters (autumn 2026, spring 2027) pass before the grant period.
    df["sem_left_sep27"] = (df.sem_left_now - 2).clip(lower=0)
    # Semesters end in January or July: 1 semester = Sep-Jan (5 months),
    # 2 semesters = Sep-Jul (11 months), 3+ = the full grant year (12 months).
    df["fund_months"] = df.sem_left_sep27.map(lambda k: 0 if k <= 0 else (5 if k == 1 else (11 if k == 2 else 12)))
    df["months_to_finish"] = 6 * df.sem_left_now - 1
    df["risk_count"] = df[RISK].sum(axis=1)
    df["resil_count"] = df[RESIL].sum(axis=1)

    df["support_ratio"] = np.where(df.family_household_income_chf > 0,
                                   df.family_income_chf / df.family_household_income_chf, np.nan)
    df["resources"] = df.family_income_chf + df.personal_income_chf
    # Monthly need in 2027/28: expenses minus family support minus EXPECTED personal income.
    df["need_2027"] = (df.monthly_expenses_chf - df.family_income_chf
                       - df.expected_personal_income_2027_chf).clip(lower=0)
    # Shortfall ratio in the grant year (share of expenses not covered in 2027/28).
    df["shortfall_ratio"] = (df.need_2027 / df.monthly_expenses_chf).clip(0, 1)
    # Period need (CHF) within the grant year.
    gross = df.need_2027 * df.fund_months
    schol = df.external_scholarship_amount_chf * df.fund_months / 12 if count_scholarship else 0
    sav_avail = (df.savings_chf - savings_buffer).clip(lower=0) if count_savings else 0
    sav_used = sav_avail * np.minimum(1, df.fund_months / df.months_to_finish.clip(lower=1))
    df["period_need_gross"] = gross
    df["period_need_net"] = (gross - schol - sav_used).clip(lower=0).round()
    df["cap_period"] = df.study_level.map(CAP) * df.fund_months / 12
    df["request"] = np.minimum(df.period_need_net, df.cap_period).round()
    # Screening flags (published rules; judgement still required).
    df["flag_no_time"] = df.fund_months == 0
    df["flag_no_need"] = df.period_need_net <= 0
    df["flag_gpa"] = df.academic_standing == "At Risk"
    df["flag_pending"] = df.residency_permit == "Pending"
    df["flag_c_high"] = (df.residency_permit == "C") & (df.family_household_income_chf >= 6_000)
    df["eligible_core"] = ~(df.flag_no_time | df.flag_no_need | df.flag_c_high)
    return df


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scoring
def proxies(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Criterion proxies on a 0-1 scale for the Call's weighted criteria."""
    tier_w = df.gni_tier.map({1: 1.0, 2: 0.5, 3: 0.0})
    under = df.geographic_region.isin(["Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia", "Latin America"]).astype(float)
    return pd.DataFrame({
        "financial": 0.6 * df.shortfall_ratio + 0.4 * tier_w,
        "academic": 0.6 * (df.gpa / 4) + 0.4 * df.progress,
        "resilience": 0.5 * df.risk_count / len(RISK) + 0.5 * df.resil_count / len(RESIL),
        "diversity": 0.5 * df.risk_first_generation + 0.25 * tier_w + 0.25 * under,
    }, index=df.index)


def score(df: pd.DataFrame, w=(0.40, 0.25, 0.20, 0.10)) -> pd.Series:
    """Weighted score (the Call's 5% 'values' criterion is not observable in the CSV)."""
    p = proxies(df)
    w = np.asarray(w, float) / np.sum(w)
    return p.financial * w[0] + p.academic * w[1] + p.resilience * w[2] + p.diversity * w[3]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- allocation
def allocate(df: pd.DataFrame, order: pd.Index, budget: float = BUDGET) -> pd.Series:
    """Greedy full awards in the given order; skip requests that no longer fit."""
    award = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    left = budget
    for i in order:
        r = df.at[i, "request"]
        if 0 < r <= left:
            award[i] = r
            left -= r
    return award


def allocate_proportional(df: pd.DataFrame, pool: pd.Index, budget: float = BUDGET) -> pd.Series:
    """Every applicant in the pool receives the same share of their request."""
    award = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    total = df.loc[pool, "request"].sum()
    k = min(1.0, budget / total) if total else 0
    award[pool] = df.loc[pool, "request"] * k
    return award


def rules(df: pd.DataFrame, seed: int = 7) -> dict[str, pd.Series]:
    """Four contrasting, defensible allocation rules (none is 'the' answer)."""
    pool = df.index[df.eligible_core & (df.request > 0)]
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    return {
        "Need-first": allocate(df, df.loc[pool].sort_values("shortfall_ratio", ascending=False).index),
        "Weighted score": allocate(df, score(df.loc[pool]).sort_values(ascending=False).index),
        "Proportional": allocate_proportional(df, pool),
        "Lottery": allocate(df, pd.Index(rng.permutation(pool))),
    }


def fmt_chf(x, _=None):
    return f"{x/1000:,.0f}k" if abs(x) >= 1000 else f"{x:,.0f}"

df = load()

sets = {
    "Need-first": allocate(df, df.loc[pool].sort_values("shortfall_ratio", ascending=False).index),
    "Weighted score": allocate(df, score(df.loc[pool]).sort_values(ascending=False).index),
    "Lottery": allocate(df, pd.Index(np.random.default_rng(7).permutation(pool))),
    "Need-first, GPA>=2.5": allocate(df, df.loc[ok].sort_values("shortfall_ratio", ascending=False).index),
    "Score, GPA>=2.5": allocate(df, score(df.loc[ok]).sort_values(ascending=False).index),
}
funded = {k: set(v.index[v > 0]) for k, v in sets.items()}
names = list(funded)
J = np.array([[len(funded[a] & funded[b]) / len(funded[a] | funded[b]) for b in names] for a in names])
fig, (a, b) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.6, 3.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.2, 1]})

for i in range(5):
    for j in range(5):
        a.text(j, i, f"{J[i, j]:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7)
a.grid(False); a.set_title("Jaccard overlap of funded sets")
times = pd.Series(0, index=pool)
for s in funded.values():
    times[list(s)] += 1
cnt = times.value_counts().reindex(range(6), fill_value=0)
b.bar(cnt.index, cnt.values, color="#40916c")
b.set_xlabel("Rules (of 5) funding the applicant"); b.set_ylabel("Eligible applicants")
b.set_title(f"Consensus is rare: {cnt[5]} funded by all,\n{cnt[0]} by none")

style()
df = load()
pool = df.index[df.eligible_core & (df.request > 0)]
e = df.loc[pool]
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
W = rng.dirichlet(np.array([40, 25, 20, 10]) / 4, size=1000)      # weights around the Call's
hits = pd.Series(0.0, index=pool)
for w in W:
    a = allocate(df, score(e, w).sort_values(ascending=False).index)
    hits += (a[pool] > 0)
p = hits / len(W)

a1.plot(np.sort(p.values)[::-1], color="#003049")
a1.axhspan(0.9, 1, color="#2a9d8f", alpha=0.15); a1.axhspan(0, 0.1, color="#c1121f", alpha=0.12)
a1.set_xlabel("Eligible applicants (sorted)"); a1.set_ylabel("P(funded) across weight sets")
a1.set_title(f"Robustly funded: {(p >= .9).sum()} | never: {(p <= .1).sum()} | contested: {((p > .1) & (p < .9)).sum()}", fontsize=8)
a2.scatter(e.shortfall_ratio, p, s=9, alpha=0.6, c=e.gni_tier.map(TIER_COL))

Figure 29 - No single optimum: trade-offs across 1,500 allocation policies.¶

(scripts/f29_pareto_tradeoff.py)

In [32]:
style()
df = load()
pool = df.index[df.eligible_core & (df.request > 0)]
e = df.loc[pool]
rng = np.random.default_rng(21)
rows = []
for k in range(1500):
    w = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(4))
    excl_gpa = rng.random() < 0.3
    idx = e[~e.flag_gpa].index if excl_gpa else e.index
    order = score(e.loc[idx], w).sort_values(ascending=False).index
    a = allocate(df, order)[pool]
    f = a > 0
    rows.append({"reach": f.sum(), "need_focus": e.loc[f, "shortfall_ratio"].mean(),
                 "tier1": a[e.gni_tier == 1].sum() / a.sum(), "gpa": e.loc[f, "gpa"].mean()})
r = pd.DataFrame(rows)
# Pareto front on (reach, need_focus, tier1)
X = r[["reach", "need_focus", "tier1"]].values
front = np.array([not np.any(np.all(X >= x, axis=1) & np.any(X > x, axis=1)) for x in X])
fig, (a1, a2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.6, 3.2))
sc = a1.scatter(r.reach, r.need_focus, c=r.tier1, cmap="viridis", s=8, alpha=0.6)
a1.scatter(r.reach[front], r.need_focus[front], facecolor="none", edgecolor="red", s=18, lw=0.6, label="Pareto-optimal")
a1.set_xlabel("Applicants funded (reach)"); a1.set_ylabel("Mean shortfall ratio of funded (need focus)")
a1.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7); fig.colorbar(sc, ax=a1, label="Share of funds to tier 1")
a2.scatter(r.need_focus, r.gpa, c=r.tier1, cmap="viridis", s=8, alpha=0.6)
a2.set_xlabel("Need focus"); a2.set_ylabel("Mean GPA of funded")
a2.set_title("Need vs merit")
a1.set_title(f"{front.sum()} of 1,500 policies are Pareto-optimal")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()  # f29_pareto_tradeoff

# that is not issued for study purposes, e.g. C, F, S, or B through family or work).
perm = ["B", "C", "F", "S"]
lv = ["Bachelor's", "Master's"]
x = np.arange(len(perm))
for k, lvl in enumerate(lv):
    d = df[df.study_level == lvl]
    share = [d.loc[d.residency_permit == p, "part_time"].mean() * 100 for p in perm]
    a.bar(x + (k - 0.5) * 0.38, share, width=0.38, color=LEVEL_COL[lvl], label=lvl)
a.set_xticks(x, perm); a.set_xlabel("Residence permit"); a.set_ylabel("% studying part-time")
a.set_title("Part-time study by permit and level"); a.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7)
# Right: current vs expected personal income in 2027/28 for part-time students.
p = df[df.part_time]
for sw, col, lab in [(False, "#8d99ae", "stays part-time"), (True, "#d62828", "switches to full-time")]:
    s = p[p.switcher == sw]
    b.scatter(s.personal_income_chf, s.expected_personal_income_2027_chf, s=14, alpha=0.7, color=col, label=lab)
lim = [0, p.personal_income_chf.max() * 1.05]
b.plot(lim, lim, "k--", lw=0.8); b.set_xlim(lim); b.set_ylim(lim)
b.set_xlabel("Personal income now (CHF/month)"); b.set_ylabel("Expected income 2027/28 (CHF/month)")
b.set_title("Part-time students: income now vs in the grant year"); b.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7, loc="upper left")
plt.show()  # f30_study_mode

Numbers quoted in the report (make_numbers.py)¶

Computes every number referenced via a LaTeX macro in the thesis text, and (re)writes numbers.tex.

df = load()
alloc = rules(df)
e = df[df.eligible_core & (df.request > 0)]
N = {}
N["nApplicants"] = len(df)
N["nBachelor"], N["nMaster"], N["nDoctoral"] = (int((df.study_level == l).sum()) for l in LEVELS)
N["nCountries"] = df.country_origin.nunique()
N["nTierOne"] = int((df.gni_tier == 1).sum())
N["medianAge"] = int(df.age.median())
for lvl, key in zip(LEVELS, ["Bach", "Mast", "Doc"]):
    N[f"medianAge{key}"] = int(df.loc[df.study_level == lvl, "age"].median())
ftb = df[(df.study_level == "Bachelor's") & ~df.part_time]
N["pctYoungBachFT"] = f"{ftb.age.between(18, 24).mean()*100:.0f}"
N["nPartTime"] = int(df.part_time.sum())
N["pctPartTime"] = f"{df.part_time.mean()*100:.0f}"
N["nSwitchers"] = int(df.switcher.sum())
N["nNeedRises"] = int((df.need_2027 > df.financial_need_chf).sum())
N["nNoTime"] = int(df.flag_no_time.sum())
N["pctSupportAboveThirty"] = f"{(df.support_ratio > 0.31).mean()*100:.0f}"
N["pctNeedZero"] = f"{(df.financial_need_chf == 0).mean()*100:.0f}"
N["medianNeed"] = f"{df.loc[df.financial_need_chf > 0, 'financial_need_chf'].median():,.0f}"
for t in (1, 2, 3):
    N[f"medianNeedTier{'ABC'[t-1]}"] = f"{df.loc[df.gni_tier == t, 'financial_need_chf'].median():,.0f}"
N["nAtRisk"] = int(df.flag_gpa.sum())
N["corrGpaNeed"] = f"{np.corrcoef(df.gpa, df.financial_need_chf)[0,1]:+.2f}"
N["pctScholarship"] = f"{df.has_external_scholarship.mean()*100:.0f}"
N["pctFirstGen"] = f"{df.risk_first_generation.mean()*100:.0f}"
N["pctWork"] = f"{df.resilience_work_experience.mean()*100:.0f}"
N["nNoNeedPeriod"] = int(df.flag_no_need.sum())
N["nCHigh"] = int(df.flag_c_high.sum())
N["nEligible"] = int(df.eligible_core.sum())
N["nPending"] = int(df.flag_pending.sum())
N["demandEligible"] = f"{e.request.sum()/1e6:.2f}"
N["oversubscription"] = f"{e.request.sum()/BUDGET:.1f}"
N["grossNeedAll"] = f"{df.period_need_gross.sum()/1e6:.2f}"
N["fundFive"] = int((df.fund_months == 5).sum())
N["fundEleven"] = int((df.fund_months == 11).sum())
N["fundTwelve"] = int((df.fund_months == 12).sum())
for k, a in alloc.items():
    key = {"Need-first": "Need", "Weighted score": "Score", "Proportional": "Prop", "Lottery": "Lot"}[k]
    N[f"funded{key}"] = int((a > 0).sum())
    N[f"tierOneShare{key}"] = f"{a[df.gni_tier == 1].sum()/a.sum()*100:.0f}"
    N[f"atRiskShare{key}"] = f"{a[df.flag_gpa].sum()/a.sum()*100:.0f}"
N["propCoverage"] = f"{alloc['Proportional'][e.index].sum()/e.request.sum()*100:.0f}"
# Monte Carlo over weights (same settings as Figure 27)
pool = e.index
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
hits = pd.Series(0.0, index=pool)
for w in rng.dirichlet(np.array([40, 25, 20, 10]) / 4, size=1000):
    hits += allocate(df, score(e, w).sort_values(ascending=False).index)[pool] > 0
p = hits / 1000
N["mcRobust"], N["mcNever"], N["mcContested"] = int((p >= .9).sum()), int((p <= .1).sum()), int(((p > .1) & (p < .9)).sum())
# Consensus across five rules (same settings as Figure 24)
ok = df.index[df.eligible_core & (df.request > 0) & ~df.flag_gpa]
sets = [allocate(df, e.sort_values("shortfall_ratio", ascending=False).index),
        allocate(df, score(e).sort_values(ascending=False).index),
        allocate(df, pd.Index(np.random.default_rng(7).permutation(pool))),
        allocate(df, df.loc[ok].sort_values("shortfall_ratio", ascending=False).index),
        allocate(df, score(df.loc[ok]).sort_values(ascending=False).index)]
times = sum((a[pool] > 0).astype(int) for a in sets)
N["consAll"], N["consNone"] = int((times == 5).sum()), int((times == 0).sum())
fs = [set(a.index[a > 0]) for a in sets]
N["jaccardNeedScore"] = f"{len(fs[0] & fs[1]) / len(fs[0] | fs[1]):.2f}"
N["jaccardNeedLottery"] = f"{len(fs[0] & fs[2]) / len(fs[0] | fs[2]):.2f}"
# Pareto analysis (same settings as Figure 29)
rng = np.random.default_rng(21)
rows = []
for k in range(1500):
    w = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(4)); excl = rng.random() < 0.3
    idx = e[~e.flag_gpa].index if excl else e.index
    a = allocate(df, score(e.loc[idx], w).sort_values(ascending=False).index)[pool]; f = a > 0
    rows.append((f.sum(), e.loc[f, "shortfall_ratio"].mean(), a[e.gni_tier == 1].sum() / a.sum()))
X = np.array(rows)
front = np.array([not np.any(np.all(X >= x, axis=1) & np.any(X > x, axis=1)) for x in X])
N["nPareto"] = int(front.sum())
N["reachMin"], N["reachMax"] = int(X[:, 0].min()), int(X[:, 0].max())
# Prefix counts under four orderings (same settings as Figure 22)
for key, idx in {"Need": e.sort_values("shortfall_ratio", ascending=False).index,
                 "Score": score(e).sort_values(ascending=False).index,
                 "Small": e.sort_values("request").index,
                 "Rand": pd.Index(np.random.default_rng(7).permutation(e.index))}.items():
    N[f"prefix{key}"] = int((e.loc[idx, "request"].cumsum() <= BUDGET).sum())
with open(ROOT / "numbers.tex", "w") as f:
    f.write("% Generated by scripts/make_numbers.py - do not edit by hand\n")
    for k, v in N.items():
        f.write(f"\\newcommand{{\\{k}}}{{{v}}}\n")
print(N)
